rationale: Hydrate and DualQueue disconnect behavior match the ticket. One blocking contract gap remains: while a step is IN_PROGRESS, _materialize_execution_reference still falls through to _get_last_completed_state_output, so the assistant message can be a prior step's output instead of empty. DualQueue is_closed change is intentional. 11 blind bullets dismissed as intended behavior or unconstrained-string/type noise; 2 edge-case items dismissed (TOCTOU send race on ThreadedGenerator, leftover IN_PROGRESS on inconsistent DB). 0 defer.

findings.title: Prior output fills in-progress message
findings.problem: While a step is IN_PROGRESS with empty output, _materialize_execution_reference still uses thoughts[-1].message then _get_last_completed_state_output, so the assistant turn message can be a previous step's result.
findings.impact: Frontend may treat a non-empty message as a finished answer during a still-running execution, contradicting the mid-run GET contract (message empty, executionStatus In Progress, thought in_progress true).
findings.recommendation: If execution.overall_status is IN_PROGRESS or any thought has in_progress true, leave message empty (do not fall back to last completed state output).
